doc: The ONE table of which ground role (open, earth, rock, path) each base tile group (MAPG number) of each god's land plays. Read by bake_ground_roles.py. 'neighbours' = the group has no role of its own: its cells take the majority role around them. verified=false is NO VERIFICADO: decided by the script (bake_ground_roles.py --infer) from the height bands and the use on the imported maps, and waiting for a human to look at it. The lands of persephone, james and charnel come from the former land_themes.py NATIVE_ROLES / JAMES_ROLES.

persephone.source: land_themes.NATIVE_ROLES (James open/earth/low ground/rock -> MG3/MG4/MG2/MG1) and the use of tu02

0.why: near-white tile 0000, the filler under void cells (land_themes build_atlas comment)

2.why: grey-green earth around the grass; the former low ground / pale paths role

3.why: grass, the largest group of tu02

5.why: lowest band, 1 tile, blends only with MG4 (pair 4-5)

james.source: land_themes.NATIVE_ROLES comment (James MG00/01/02/03) and base_mapping for the groups with no band

pyro.source: NO VERIFICADO: bake_ground_roles.py --infer (open = most used banded group on Roads, rock = highest band, path = lowest band, the rest earth)

0.why: most used on Roads (27 993 cells), band 0.20-0.35

4.why: no height band, unused on Roads

stratos.source: NO VERIFICADO: bake_ground_roles.py --infer (open = most used banded group on WinterWonder, rock = highest band, path = lowest of the rest, the rest earth)

0.why: band 0.10-0.65, lowest centre after the open group; 21 163 cells on WinterWonder, so it may really be open ground

2.why: most used on WinterWonder (33 420 cells), lowest band 0.00-0.15, blue-white ice

5.why: no height band, unused on WinterWonder
